title: Fix missing model direct download UI state
key_points: Store Electron missing-model refs with desktop `downloadId` when available, falling back to URL for older desktop builds
Normalize the new desktop `{ ok, download, error? }` start result while preserving legacy boolean bridge behavior
Resolve missing-model status by `downloadId` first so same-URL rows do not steal each other's progress
Pass the stable identifier through model-library pause/resume/cancel controls
asserts: The frontend bridge consumes the desktop `downloadId` contract from Comfy-Org/desktop#1694 to bind each missing-model row to the exact download returned by desktop.
